name: Zankou Kaiga ~Soredemo Boku wa, Nii-san to~
original_name: 残光絵画 ～それでも僕は、兄さんと～
source:
A world in which humans are no longer treated like humans.
When will it be? It will be anytime now.
A story of two brothers' longing, lust, and sad love that sprouted in such a world.

Consists of three short stories.
translation:
一个人类不再被当作人类对待的世界。
会是什么时候呢？现在随时都会有。
两兄弟在这样的世界中萌芽的渴望、欲望和悲伤的爱情的故事。

由三个短篇小说组成。
